title: Forecast Horizon Discrepancy & Over-exposure
root_cause: Model Registry and UI advertised H=1..8 for refit models, conflicting with approved serving scope H=1..4 for CatBoost MAE champion.
remediation: Constrained supported_horizons strictly to [1,2,3,4] in registry and schema (conint ge=1 le=4). Added runtime UnsupportedHorizonException. Removed H=8 from frontend dropdown. Rebuilt frontend dist.

title: Replenishment Protection Period Horizon Extrapolation
root_cause: When protection period L+R > available forecast steps, planning service silently summed available steps without error, understating gross requirements.
remediation: Added explicit guard: if protection_period > max_available_horizon, raises AppException(status_code=422, error_code=VALIDATION_ERROR).

title: PBKDF2 Password Hashing Below OWASP 2023/2024 Benchmark
root_cause: Default iteration count was 100,000, below OWASP cheat sheet recommendation of 600,000 for PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256.
remediation: Upgraded PBKDF2_ITERATIONS to 600,000. Implemented transparent auto-rehash on successful login for legacy hashes. Added POST /api/v1/auth/bootstrap for secure initial setup.

title: JWT Algorithm Allowlist and Token Lifetime Hardening
root_cause: JWT decoding lacked explicit algorithm allowlist enforcement (RFC 8725 BCP) and default session lifetime was 480 minutes (8 hours).
remediation: Enforced algorithms=['HS256'] in decode_access_token with AlgorithmMismatchException. Added mandatory exp/nbf/iat checks with 5s clock skew. Reduced default token lifetime to 120 minutes.

title: Potential Formula / DDE Injection in CSV Exports
root_cause: Export CSV cells were not sanitized against leading spreadsheet formula characters (=, +, -, @, tab, cr).
remediation: Implemented sanitize_csv_cell prefixing formula triggers with a single quote (') while preserving SKU codes and numbers intact.

title: Export File Path Traversal Defense
root_cause: File path resolution could theoretically allow traversal if invalid run_id or export_id with path delimiters entered the service.
remediation: Added parameter validation rejecting '..', '/', and '\\' in run_id and export_id, raising ExportFileMissingOrCorruptException.

title: Test Suite Contract Synchronization
root_cause: Legacy tests hardcoded expectations of H=8 and 100k iterations, and bootstrap test altered admin credentials without restoration.
remediation: Updated assertions to H=1..4 and 600k hashes; wrapped bootstrap test in try...finally to restore seed credentials.
